hero_desc: Combine professional efficiency with the art of living in an inspiring historic setting.
intro_text1: L’Hostellerie Saint-Louis offers flexible work spaces bathed in natural light. Give your staff, management committees or partners a calm, privileged environment that stimulates creativity and strengthens team cohesion.
intro_text2: State-of-the-art technology, a dedicated concierge service and tailor-made catering from our gastronomic restaurant PAUZE.
atouts_desc: From small committee meetings to full residential seminars, we adapt our spaces and services to your requirements.
scard1_desc: Bright rooms with high-definition projection screens, video-conferencing equipment and high-speed fibre Wi-Fi.
scard2_desc: Make the most of our 27 high-end rooms and suites (twin rooms available) to accommodate your teams during multi-day stays.
scard3_desc: Welcome coffee, artisan pastries, fruit breaks, business lunches and private dinners at the PAUZE restaurant.
scard4_desc: Private hire of the Saint-Louis Spa (120 m²) and activities to discover Flanders to strengthen team cohesion.
quote_desc: Our corporate team is at your disposal to design a bespoke event suited to your budget and objectives.
capacities_section_title: Capacities & Layouts of Our Meeting Rooms
capacities_section_desc: Offer your staff and partners an exceptional setting. Our modular rooms adapt elegantly to every professional format, from the executive meeting to the corporate cocktail.

seminar_capacities_liste.room_desc: A room bathed in natural light, ideal for plenary sessions, working seminars and project presentations.
